# Kavolith Group

> An Intelligence Systems Company engineering AI systems for revenue, operations, and workforce automation. Based in Hyderabad, India.

Kavolith Group operates four brands: Kavolith (AI systems engineering services), CogniLeads OS (AI Revenue Intelligence Platform), Kavolith Intelligence (Enterprise AI Workforce Platform, presale), and Kavolith Automation (automation engineering).

Prices are displayed in USD by default, with EUR and INR available as toggles. A flat FOUNDER30 discount (30% off) applies across all regions.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kavolith.com): Group overview, the four brands, and the Proof of Work section.
- [Kavolith](https://kavolith.com/kavolith): Core services — systems audit, custom workflow builds, intelligence layer. Tiers: Launchpad, Scale, Premium.
- [CogniLeads OS](https://kavolith.com/cognileads-os): AI Revenue Intelligence Platform. Capture, score, route, convert.
- [Kavolith Intelligence](https://kavolith.com/kavolith-intelligence): Enterprise AI Workforce Platform — multilingual digital employees. Coming soon, build-slot reservations open.
- [Kavolith Automation](https://kavolith.com/kavolith-automation): Automation tiers — Single Flow, Ops Stack, Automation Control.
- [About](https://kavolith.com/about): Background, principles, and location.
- [Contact](https://kavolith.com/contact): Consultation request form.
- [Privacy](https://kavolith.com/privacy): Privacy policy, compliant with India's DPDP Act 2023.
- [Sitemap](https://kavolith.com/sitemap.xml)

## Proof of work (verified facts only)

- TLEGAL — Advocate Portal: live client build at https://tlegal.org.in. Hand-coded on TanStack Start, React 19, Bun, Tailwind CSS v4; Airtable-backed case intake; built to comply with India's DPDP Act 2023.
- Kavolith Automation lead capture pipeline: in production on Make.com. Webhook-triggered lead capture, AI classification, auto-routing to Airtable, Telegram, and email.
- CogniLeads OS: architecture and capability only — 130+ files, 40+ modules, FastAPI backend. Not a live client deployment.

## Kavolith Intelligence presale packages

- AI Compliance & Documentation Employee — multilingual (English, Telugu, Hindi), one-month advance booking.
- AI HR/Ops Digital Employee — multilingual (English, Telugu, Hindi), one-month advance booking.

## Automation types built by Kavolith Automation

Lead routing, invoice generation and follow-up, CRM synchronisation, inbound enquiry capture and qualification, document collection and validation, appointment reminders, approval escalation, scheduled reporting.
